image_description: A full-body side view of an American Bison standing on a dirt path with grass in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. It has short curved horns, a beard, and sturdy legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, showing a broad profile and short, upward-curving horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible and appears dark/black, matching the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and partially obscured by the thick mane/fur on the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic heavy build and height at the shoulders typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a clear textural and color contrast between the shaggy, dark forequarters/hump and the rest of the body.
The rear half of the body has visibly shorter, smoother hair compared to the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are proportionally small relative to the massive head and body.
Legs appear thick and sturdy. While ground contact obscures the exact hoof detail, the visible lower leg structure is consistent with cloven-hoofed anatomy.
The tail is visible hanging down, appearing short with a darker, bushier end.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and their connection to the massive torso, ensuring no limb fusion or extra limbs.
To check for 'melting' artifacts where the shaggy fur meets the background, a common AI failure point for complex textures.
To assess general texture consistency and lighting realism.

focus_areas: Fur texture transition between forequarters and hindquarters
Edge definition of the shaggy mane against the background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy front fur and the smoother rear fur. AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Also, verify that the legs do not merge into the belly fur or the ground.
